name: Discord
description: Send alerts to a Discord channel (using webhooks).

USE_DISCORD.help: Enable sending alerts to a Discord channel.
USE_DISCORD.label: Use Discord

DISCORD_RETRY_IF_LIMITED.help: Retry to send the request if Discord API is rate limiting us (may consume a lot of resources).
DISCORD_RETRY_IF_LIMITED.label: Retry if limited by Discord

DISCORD_ALERT_IPS.help: Only notify denied requests from these IPs/networks (separated with spaces). Leave empty to notify every denied request.
DISCORD_ALERT_IPS.label: Alert IPs

DISCORD_UNLISTED_THRESHOLD.help: When DISCORD_ALERT_IPS is set, send one notification for each IP not in the list that is denied this many times within DISCORD_UNLISTED_PERIOD (0 to disable).
DISCORD_UNLISTED_THRESHOLD.label: Unlisted IPs threshold

DISCORD_UNLISTED_PERIOD.help: Period in seconds used to count denied requests per IP not in DISCORD_ALERT_IPS.
DISCORD_UNLISTED_PERIOD.label: Unlisted IPs period

DISCORD_BAN_ALERT.help: When DISCORD_ALERT_IPS is set, send one escalated notification when a watched IP gets banned (added to the ban list), and mute the per-request block alerts for it while the ban lasts.
DISCORD_BAN_ALERT.label: Alert on watched IP ban

DISCORD_BAN_MENTION.help: Optional mention prepended to the ban notification only (e.g. @here or <@&roleID> for Discord). Leave empty to disable.
DISCORD_BAN_MENTION.label: Ban alert mention

DISCORD_FORMAT.help: Message format: 'default' (built-in rich embed) or 'template' (custom, uses DISCORD_TEMPLATE).
DISCORD_FORMAT.label: Message format

DISCORD_TEMPLATE.help: Custom notification payload (raw JSON) used when DISCORD_FORMAT=template. Supports {{variables}} and {{#if var}}...{{/if}} sections; values are JSON-escaped and the result must be valid JSON (falls back to default if not).
DISCORD_TEMPLATE.label: Custom template
